From handwoven cotton tops and billowy beach dresses, to boho accessories and home decor, we’ve compiled our list of go-to stores to get your retail-therapy loving senses tingling with excitement. Mermaid’s Boutique/DADAblui Mermaids Boutique, Anjuna See On Map Call (+919822197015) Mermaid’s Boutique was started by expat Katya Grew in 2001. The store hosts several brands, including Katya’s own brand DADAblui . Their one-of-a-kind pieces, like their intricately embroidered banjara bags embellished with old coins, mirrors and colourful tassels, are worth blowing next month’s salary on. With its popping colours and quirky décor, it's kind of hard to miss in Anjuna. Chock full of embroidered jackets, bags, boho clothes, accessories and swimwear, this boutique comes recommended for those who love colours, prints, and a bohemian style. However, beyond its well-known attractions lies a shopper’s paradise packed with bustling markets, unique boutiques, and local treasures waiting to be discovered. Whether you’re on the hunt for traditional Goan products, trendy beachwear, or unique souvenirs, this ultimate shopping guide will help you uncover the best places to shop in Goa. So grab your shopping bags and let’s dive in! The Best Markets in Goa Anjuna Flea Market The Anjuna Flea Market is an iconic destination located in North Goa. Held every Wednesday, this sprawling market offers everything from handcrafted jewelry and clothing to unique souvenirs and artworks created by local artisans. Bargaining is the norm, so be prepared to haggle for the best deals. BOOK HOTELS NEAR ANJUNA MARKET Mapusa Market Located in the town of Mapusa, Friday is the special market day where locals and tourists flock to buy everything from spices, fruits, and vegetables to clothing, homeware, and handicrafts. The Mapusa Market truly offers an authentic Goan shopping experience. BOOK A STAY NEAR MAPUSA MARKET Calangute M

payload.text_excerpt: Best Boutiques In Mumbai | LBB. Mumbai Similar Guides Women's Fashion Boutiques 11 Best Boutiques In Mumbai That'll Make Shopping A Memorable Experience By Krati 12992 Interested | 63K Views The fashion capital of India, Mumbai, is the Mecca of boutiques by designers big and small. The city is home to a few of the most recognised designer labels, with boutiques that house apparel and home decor that have been hand-picked from the most fashion-forward cities in the world. Trendy apparel, trendier accessories and a host of other knick-knacks that could run steep are a common find at these independent stores, and we've rounded up the crème de la crème of those within the budget. So, here's a list of some of the best boutiques in Mumbai. Now all you need to do is bookmark this and get shopping! Overview 1 . Anokhi 2 . Mesh: Your Fashion Runway 3 . Nautica 4 . Clothes Rack 5 . Madison 6 . Shay 7 . Melange 8 . BigCee 9 . Wardrobe 10 . Fuss Pot 11 . Roots Fashion Studio Anokhi Anokhi, Bandra West, Mumbai See On Map Call (+912262515610) If you haven't heard of Anokhi , you've been living under a rock! Check Out The Sunshine State's Indie Boutique Scene For Fashion To Decor By Heena 39889 Interested | 281K Views Balmy beaches and chill vibes aside, Goa is also home to many independent designers from all over the world. From handwoven cotton tops and billowy beach dresses, to boho accessories and home decor, we’ve compiled our list of go-to stores to get your retail-therapy loving senses tingling with excitement. Mermaid’s Boutique/DADAblui Mermaids Boutique, Anjuna See On Map Call (+919822197015) Mermaid’s Boutique was started by expat Katya Grew in 2001. The store hosts several brands, including Katya’s own brand DADAblui . Their one-of-a-kind pieces, like their intricately embroidered banjara bags embellished with old coins, mirrors and colourful tassels, are worth blowing next month’s salary on. With its popping colours and quirky décor, it's kind of hard to miss in Anjuna. Chock full of embroidered jackets, bags, boho clothes, accessories and swimwear, this boutique comes recommended for those who love colours, prints, and a bohemian style. However, beyond its well-known attractions lies a shopper’s paradise packed with bustling markets, unique boutiques, and local treasures waiting to be discovered. Whether you’re on the hunt for traditional Goan products, trendy beachwear, or unique souvenirs, this ultimate shopping guide will help you uncover the best places to shop in Goa. So grab your shopping bags and let’s dive in! The Best Markets in Goa Anjuna Flea Market The Anjuna Flea Market is an iconic destination located in North Goa. Held every Wednesday, this sprawling market offers everything from handcrafted jewelry and clothing to unique souvenirs and artworks created by local artisans. Bargaining is the norm, so be prepared to haggle for the best deals. BOOK HOTELS NEAR ANJUNA MARKET Mapusa Market Located in the town of Mapusa, Friday is the special market day where locals and tourists flock to buy everything from spices, fruits, and vegetables to clothing, homeware, and handicrafts. We’ve slowly started shifting over to organic fashion labels, and here, we give you a list of stores where you can find some of the best, trendiest and comfortable organic fashion labels in town. Anavila Anavila, Khar, Mumbai See On Map VISIT SITE This label was launched in 2011 and has maintained versatility in its essence since then. They believe in recycling and upcycling, and their products are made from leftover textiles, or by upcycling the waste that can be utilised in textures. Visit to get your hands on organic textiles that are trendy, comfortable, and perfect for that occasion you’ve been planning an outfit for. #LBBTip - we hear the saris at this store are a big hit with the celebrities. Nicobar Nicobar, Fort, Mumbai See On Map VISIT SITE Since summer is in full swing, their dresses and tunics are going to be our go-to outfits when it comes to meetings and those fancy work parties. Before the list, it helps to know what separates a truly great multi-designer store from a mediocre one: Curation over volume: The best stores are selective. Here are Condé Nast Traveller's selections of five favourite boutiques that promise pure shopping bliss: The Collective The Collective knows that shopping isn't just a girly pastime. Here you'll find the best of Indian and Western design for both women and men, enough to spoil anyone silly. Diane von Furstenberg, Juicy Couture and Prada hold court alongside famed Indian designers Rohit Bal, Rajesh Pratap Singh and Tarun Tahiliani. The Collective, 40, Vittal Mallya Road, Bengaluru (+91 80 6767 8888; www.thecollective.in ) RainTree Housed in a handsome 75-year old colonial bungalow, RainTree is a favourite stop for the fashion-forward. Collections from seasoned designers like Ritu Kumar and Wendell Rodricks are featured here alongside new entrants like Jason Cherian. RainTree also stocks a range of beautiful furniture, jewellery and beauty products by Ally Matthan. Recharge after a shopping spree
